summary: Verified all 4 one-click demo logins on the web panel /login page. Admin, Partner, Customer, and Merchant buttons all sign in successfully and route to their respective dashboards (/admin, /partner, /account, /merchant). No 'Demo login failed' toast appeared, and no CORS errors were captured in the browser console. Success toast 'Demo login: <name>' is visible (e.g., 'Demo login: Sharma Electricals' seen on merchant).
critical_code_review_comments: web_panel/.env keeping REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL empty so api.js falls back to same-origin + /api works correctly, avoiding CORS on preview URL.
Minor console warnings on admin dashboard from recharts (width/height=-1) and two 403s (likely notifications permission). Non-blocking.
